entries.title: 以假亂真的 Deepfake 事件簿：拜登、湯姆克魯斯都曾是主角？連戰爭、選舉訊息都不放過
entries.summary: 這篇報導深入探討了「Deepfake」技術的發展及其對社會的影響。起源於深度學習造假技術的Deepfake，最初應用於製作色情片，但隨著時間的推移，其應用範圍擴展到政治和戰爭領域。文章從全球角度分析了過百個 Deepfake 假訊息事件，揭示了這些假訊息的趨勢和實際影響。報導指出，儘管目前遇到的 Deepfake 相對少且品質低落，但人們對其的恐懼遠大於實際帶來的影響。文章亦討論了 AI 技術的快速發展，以及必須從源頭改變來遏止 Deepfake 技術濫用的重要性。

entries.summary: 這篇報導全面檢視了台灣車禍事故死亡資料，探討了台灣成為行人地獄的原因。2022年，台灣共發生1755件死亡事故，其中大客車和營業用車事故死亡率較高。報導分析了事故肇因，主要包括未注意車前狀態、未依規定讓車，以及酒駕問題。尤其在台中、屏東、新北，酒駕比例較高。報導還提到，政府的改善方針著重於限制機車族，引發爭議。透過分析交通事故統計資料，報導揭示了台灣道路安全的嚴峻問題，特別是對行人的安全風險。

Over the years, it has grown to become a significant player in the Indian media landscape. Dainik Bhaskar publishes editions in multiple cities, with a presence in over 12 states, including major ones like Madhya Pradesh, Rajasthan, Haryana, Gujarat, and Uttar Pradesh. It has editions in multiple cities, providing local news alongside national and international coverage. It is known for its bold journalism, in-depth reporting, and investigative stories. Dainik Bhaskar plays a major role in shaping public opinion, especially in Hindi-speaking regions. It is considered a trusted source of information for millions of readers.

entries.title: Disarming Environmental Disinformation
entries.org: From the Center for Collaborative Investigative Journalism:“Forest is life” — But Nigeria’s last rainforest is falling fast. Southern Nigerian communities depend on the rainforest. So do endangered gorillas. But illegal logging, mining and disinformation leave them vulnerable. in the story is a Metaverse virtual reality version of the reporting so you can better understand the rainforest destruction. The story is also being broadcast on radio in Efik/Ibibio, a language local to Cross River State, where the story is set. From Arab Reporters for Investigative Journalism:Coordinated Social Media Campaigns From Oil-rich Arabic States Spread Climate Denial. Petroleum accounts lead disinformation campaign on climate change Tempo in Indonesia:Mining For Likes: A Nickel Company Polishes Their Image. How the Indonesian nickel industry hires influencers to make it appear green and discount environmental damage: Disinformation in Central Halmahera: Communities continue to voice their opposition to mining activities in Central Halmahera. Now they are taking the fight to social media. Nickel Waste in Weda Bay About The Down-streaming of Nickel Mining: Social media is inundated with disinformation about the down-streaming of nickel mines. The disinformation is covering up environmental damage. Mongabay’s Latin America desk:How a ‘green gold rush’ in the Amazon led to dubious carbon deals on Indigenous lands. rise of Miami-based CC35 and the business behind its questionable climate deals in Argentina, Brazil, Bolivia and Paraguay Sumaúma in BrazilIn Northeast Brazil, the mining company Mineração Rio do Norte -- backed by Switzerland’s Glencore and Great Britain’s Rio Tinto -- wants to rapidly cut into forest and expand its bauxite mining. But to do that, the company supposedly needs permission from two indigenous groups -- the Quilombola and Ribeirinho peoples. At least that is what laws call for. Now a federal prosecutor is calling for its mining permits to be canceled because the company violated the rights of those groups by not properly consulting them. English - - -
